parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The mode of the Intelligent Protection policy. Valid values:

*   **normal**
*   **loose**
*   **strict**

parameters.name: Switch
parameters.description:
Specifies the status of the Intelligent Protection policy. Valid values:

*   **on**: enables the policy.
*   **off**: disables the policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-port-auto-cc-status --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --switch on --biz-mode normal --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo ModifyPortAutoCcStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Switch on --InstanceId 'ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000' --Mode normal
